== Summary ==
Identified: [[Michael Raveling]], [[Jim Li]]. Only Michael and Jim in the standings; which is which not marked.

== Description ==

Game 2: [[Michael Raveling]] vs [[Jim Li]]. At the [[June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (1 June)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 1 June 2003.
